install.allowedWebsitesHint: Websites where your chat can start conversations. Enter one domain per line, e.g. shop.com or *.shop.com for every subdomain (www.shop.com needs its own line or the wildcard). * allows any website: anyone who copies your organization ID could run your chat, and its AI usage, on their own site. Replace * with your domains before going live.

The signature is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the customer ID. Without a valid signature, the visitor is treated as a new anonymous customer.

businessHours.title: Business hours
businessHours.description: When your team answers each channel. Outside these hours the AI keeps answering, and conversations that need a person wait in the queue until you open.

quickCheck.title: Quick check with the team
quickCheck.description: When the AI doesn't know a fact ("does this vase come gift-boxed?"), it asks your team instead of handing the whole chat over, and keeps answering the customer's other questions. Everyone on the team gets a notification and an email with a one-tap answer link. Outside business hours, or when nobody is reachable, the question goes straight to your queue.

quickCheck.giveUpAfter: Pass it to the team queue after (minutes)
quickCheck.preview: The customer is told they'll hear back within {giveUp} minutes, gets an update at {update} minutes, and if nobody has answered by then the chat joins your queue. A late answer still reaches them.
quickCheck.invalid: Use whole minutes from 1 to 60, with the update before the hand-off.

scim.title: Automatic provisioning (SCIM)
scim.description: Let your identity provider add, update and remove people and groups. Use the URL and token below as the SCIM connector settings (Okta: SCIM 2.0 base URL with HTTP header authentication; Entra: tenant URL and secret token).
scim.noToken: No token yet. Generate one to turn provisioning on.

scim.rules: Only addresses on your verified domains can be provisioned. Owners are never changed or removed through SCIM. Removing someone ends their sessions here, closes their open connections and revokes their API tokens for this organization; if this was their only organization their account is deactivated. Group names map to roles through the group mapping above, never to owner.
